decisions.statement: The recipient resolver sits outside the fleet that resolver serves.
The armed specs are assembled afresh on every tick rather than fixed at start.
The specs are the personas enumerated on the tick together with the handlers named outright.
Each spec's inbound messages are read on every tick.
A seat is revived only where its page is not there and inbound work matches that seat.
The recipient resolver's configuration is stated when that resolver starts.
A tick that throws is reported and the loop goes on.
The recipient resolver runs until stopped.
A stop ends the loop at its next boundary.

definition: an absent seat revived when its work arrives
